elements.title: The BlindFed Framework

figure.caption: Overview of the BlindFed framework: architecture redesign, offline distillation, and online adaptation.

bullets: Redesigns models with FHE-friendly polynomial approximations for non-linear layers
Uses two-stage split learning to train adapters via encrypted inference
Mitigates model extraction attacks through Stochastic Block Sampling (SBS)

builds.audio_segment: BlindFed redesigns models with FHE-friendly polynomial approximations,
It uses two-stage split learning to train local adapters without backpropagation through the backbone.
Finally, privacy-boosting schemes like stochastic block sampling protect the model from extraction attacks while maintaining adaptation performance.
